# Tech Mind Developers

> Tech Mind Developers (TMD) is an established full-cycle software engineering company founded in 2014, headquartered in Okhla Industrial Area, New Delhi, India, with technical delivery centers in Aligarh, Uttar Pradesh. The firm specializes in bespoke enterprise ERP systems, AI chatbots, mobile application development, diagnostic pathology lab software (LIMS), educational institute ERPs, and industrial manufacturing automation with 100% lifetime source code ownership and zero monthly software rent.

## Geographical Footprint & Delivery Centers
- **Headquarters (Delhi NCR)**: Okhla Industrial Area, New Delhi, Delhi 110020, India
- **Regional Delivery Hub (UP)**: Aligarh, Uttar Pradesh, India
- **Delhi NCR Coverage**: South Delhi, Nehru Place, Noida, Greater Noida, Gurgaon, Faridabad
- **Uttar Pradesh Coverage**: Aligarh, Lucknow, Agra, Meerut
- **Global Delivery Footprint**: Pan-India, United States, United Kingdom, and the United Arab Emirates

## Industries Served
- **Healthcare & Diagnostic Centers**: Pathology LIMS, diagnostic reporting, and dental clinic management
- **Education & Institutions**: School ERP, college administration, coaching academy student portals
- **Manufacturing & Supply Chain**: Production tracking, job-work challans, inventory, and export billing
- **Retail & E-Commerce**: D2C storefronts, B2B wholesale distribution, and UPI payment automation
- **Fitness & Wellness**: Gym website development, online member portals, diet charts, and WhatsApp fee renewals
- **Corporate & Professional Services**: Custom CRM, billing portals, and automated business workflows

## Engineering Stack
- **Backend**: Python (Django, FastAPI), C# / ASP.NET Core, Node.js, PHP
- **Frontend**: React, Next.js, HTML5, CSS3, Modern JavaScript, Tailwind CSS
- **Mobile**: Flutter, React Native, Native Android (Kotlin), iOS (Swift)
- **Databases**: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, Redis, MongoDB
- **Cloud & DevOps**: AWS, Microsoft Azure, Linux VPS (Ubuntu), Docker, Nginx, Cloudflare
- **Hardware & API Integrations**: WhatsApp Cloud API, Razorpay, Cashfree, UPI QR, Biometric machines (eSSL, ZKTeco via SDK), Electronic weighing scales (RS232 serial)

1. **100% Code Ownership**: Clients obtain complete intellectual property, database schema, and source code with zero monthly software licensing fees.

3. **Production Track Record**: Over 12 years of deployment history across healthcare labs, schools, factories, and commercial enterprises.
